blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices and directrices of the ellipse whose equation is given and sketch its graph: \(4x^2 + 9y^2 = 36\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 'equation se features' wala sawal hai: equation di hui hai aur us se ellipse ke saare hisse nikalne hain.
Pehle dono sides ko 36 se divide kar ke standard form banayenge, kyunke standard form mein hi \(a\) aur \(b\) seedhe nazar aate hain.
Phir \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\) se \(c\), aur us se foci, eccentricity, vertices aur directrices.
Aakhir mein in points ki madad se sketch banayenge.
Sketch ke liye pehle saare points ki qeematein nikal lijiye, phir graph banaiye; is se drawing saaf aur sahi banti hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(4x^2 + 9y^2 = 36\).
Maloom karna: centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices, directrices; aur sketch.
Tareeqa: right side 1 banao, standard form se muqabla karo, phir 6.4.2 ke formulas lagao.

Standard form
\[\frac{4x^2}{36} + \frac{9y^2}{36} = 1\]
\[\frac{x^2}{9} + \frac{y^2}{4} = 1\]
Kyun: 36 se divide karne par right side 1 ho jati hai; \(\frac{4}{36} = \frac{1}{9}\) aur \(\frac{9}{36} = \frac{1}{4}\).

\(a\) aur \(b\) parhein
\[a^2 = 9,\ a = 3; \quad b^2 = 4,\ b = 2\]
Kyun: bara denominator 9 \(x^2\) ke neeche hai, is liye major axis x-axis par hai aur \(a^2 = 9\).
Dhyan dein: \(a^2 = 4\) mat samjhiye sirf is liye ke 4 pehle likha tha; bara denominator dekhiye.

\(c\) nikalein
\[c^2 = a^2 - b^2 = 9 - 4 = 5\]
\[c = \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: ellipse ka rishta; c centre se focus ka faasla hai.

Centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices
\[\text{Centre } (0, 0), \quad \text{foci } (\pm\sqrt{5}, 0)\]
\[e = \frac{c}{a} = \frac{\sqrt{5}}{3}\]
\[\text{Vertices } (\pm 3, 0)\]
Kyun: origin par centre wala horizontal ellipse: foci \((\pm c, 0)\), vertices \((\pm a, 0)\). \(e \approx 0.75\), jo 1 se kam hai, theek.

Directrices
\[x = \pm\frac{a}{e} = \pm\frac{3}{\sqrt{5}/3}\]
\[= \pm\frac{9}{\sqrt{5}} = \pm\frac{9\sqrt{5}}{5}\]
Kyun: directrices major axis par perpendicular hain aur centre se \(\frac{a}{e}\) faasle par. \(\frac{3}{\sqrt{5}/3}\) mein neeche wale 3 ko upar le gaye, \(3 \times 3 = 9\). Phir rationalize kiya: \(\frac{9}{\sqrt{5}} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{5}} = \frac{9\sqrt{5}}{5} \approx 4.02\).

Sketch
Vertices \((\pm 3, 0)\), co-vertices \((0, \pm 2)\), foci \((\pm\sqrt{5}, 0) \approx (\pm 2.24, 0)\) plot kar ke hamwar oval banaiye, aur bahar \(x \approx \pm 4.02\) par directrices.
Kyun: chaar kinare aur centre curve ko tay karte hain; foci aur directrices sawal mein maange gaye hain, is liye un ko bhi dikhaya.

Ek nazar mein
Equation se features nikalne ka nizaam yaad rakhiye: right side 1 karo, bara denominator dekho, \(a\) aur \(b\) parho, \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\), phir centre, foci, vertices, eccentricity aur directrices ek ke baad ek. Sketch hamesha aakhir mein, jab saare points maloom hon. Directrix ka jawab rationalize kar ke likhna achha hai, magar \(\frac{9}{\sqrt{5}}\) bhi bilkul sahi jawab hai.

Tasdeeq
\(b^2 = a^2(1 - e^2) = 9(1 - \frac{5}{9}) = 4\). Foci andar \((2.24 < 3)\) aur directrices bahar \((4.02 > 3)\) hain, jaisa hona chahiye.
Kyun: doosre raaste se wohi b-squared aaya, aur tasweer bhi qaide ke mutabiq hai.

answer_figure.alt: Horizontal ellipse x^2/9 + y^2/4 = 1 centred at the origin: vertices (-3, 0) and (3, 0), co-vertices (0, 2) and (0, -2), foci (-root 5, 0) and (root 5, 0), and dashed vertical directrices x = -9/root 5 and x = 9/root 5 outside the ellipse.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices and directrices of the ellipse whose equation is given and sketch its graph: \(4x^2 + 24x + 9y^2 - 36y + 36 = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi part (i) jaisa sawal hai, magar equation general shakal mein hai, is liye centre origin par nahi.
\(x\) aur \(y\) dono mein complete the square kar ke translated standard form banayenge.
Phir \(h\), \(k\), \(a\), \(b\) parh kar har feature ko centre ke hisaab se khiskayenge.
Answer key is part ki directrices mein ghalti karti hai; hum dekhenge kahan.
Yaad rahe: vertical directrix ki equation x = ... hoti hai, is liye us mein centre ka h jama hota hai, k nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(4x^2 + 24x + 9y^2 - 36y + 36 = 0\).
Maloom karna: centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices, directrices; aur sketch.
Tareeqa: complete the square, right side 1, phir Theorem 1 se muqabla.

Squares complete karein
\[4(x^2 + 6x) + 9(y^2 - 4y) + 36 = 0\]
\[4[(x+3)^2 - 9] + 9[(y-2)^2 - 4]\]
\[\quad + 36 = 0\]
\[4(x+3)^2 - 36 + 9(y-2)^2 - 36 + 36 = 0\]
\[4(x+3)^2 + 9(y-2)^2 = 36\]
Kyun: bracket ke andar 6 ka aadha 3, aur \(3^2 = 9\); \(-4\) ka aadha \(-2\), aur \((-2)^2 = 4\). Bahar nikalte waqt 9 ko 4 se aur 4 ko 9 se zarb diya, is liye \(-36\) aur \(-36\) aaye.
Dhyan dein: sirf \(-9\) aur \(-4\) minus karna aam ghalti hai; bracket ke bahar wala coefficient bhoolna nahi.

36 se divide karein
\[\frac{(x+3)^2}{9} + \frac{(y-2)^2}{4} = 1\]
Kyun: standard form mein right side 1 hoti hai.

\(h\), \(k\), \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) parhein
\[h = -3,\ k = 2,\ a^2 = 9,\ b^2 = 4\]
\[c^2 = 9 - 4 = 5 \Rightarrow c = \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: bara denominator \(x\) wale term ke neeche hai, is liye major axis horizontal hai (line \(y = 2\)). \(x + 3 = x - (-3)\) se \(h = -3\).

Centre, foci, eccentricity
\[\text{Centre } (-3, 2)\]
\[\text{Foci } (h \pm c, k) = (-3 \pm \sqrt{5}, 2)\]
\[e = \frac{c}{a} = \frac{\sqrt{5}}{3}\]
Kyun: Theorem 1. Eccentricity sirf shakal batati hai, jagah nahi, is liye yeh part (i) jaisi hi hai.

Vertices
\[(h \pm a, k) = (-3 \pm 3, 2)\]
\[(0, 2) \text{ aur } (-6, 2)\]
Kyun: vertices major axis par centre se a faasle par.

Directrices
\[x = h \pm \frac{a}{e} = -3 \pm \frac{9}{\sqrt{5}}\]
Kyun: vertical lines, jo centre ke x-coordinate \(h = -3\) se naapi jati hain; taqreeban \(x \approx 1.02\) aur \(x \approx -7.02\).
Dhyan dein: yahan \(k = 2\) nahi, \(h = -3\) jama hota hai, kyunke directrix ki equation \(x = \ldots\) hai.

Sketch
\(C(-3, 2)\), vertices \((0, 2)\), \((-6, 2)\), co-vertices \((-3, 4)\), \((-3, 0)\), foci \((-3 \pm 2.24, 2)\) plot kar ke hamwar oval banaiye; directrices dashed lines.
Kyun: yeh points curve ko tay karte hain.

Ek nazar mein
Yeh part dikhata hai ke general equation dekh kar ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi. Complete the square ke baad yeh wohi ellipse nikla jo part (i) mein tha, bas jagah badal gayi. Exam mein aisa ho to har feature ko part (i) se mila kar foran tasdeeq kar sakte hain: foci, vertices aur directrices sab \((-3, 2)\) se khiske hue hone chahiye, aur eccentricity bilkul wohi rehni chahiye. Answer key ne directrices mein \(k = 2\) jama kar diya, jab ke vertical lines ki equation \(x = \ldots\) mein hamesha \(h\) aata hai. Yeh ghalti bachche bhi aksar karte hain, is liye dhyan rakhiye: \(x = \ldots\) wali line ke saath \(h\), aur \(y = \ldots\) wali line ke saath \(k\).

Tasdeeq
Vertex \((0, 2)\) asal equation mein: \(0 + 0 + 36 - 72 + 36 = 0\). Yeh part (i) wala ellipse hi hai, bas 3 left aur 2 upar khiskaya hua; har feature \((-3, 2)\) se khiska hai.
Kyun: is tarah dono parts ek doosre ki tasdeeq karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein directrices \(x = 2 \pm \frac{9}{\sqrt{5}}\) likhi hain. Is mein \(h = -3\) ki jagah \(k = 2\) laga diya gaya hai. Major axis horizontal hai, is liye directrices \(x = h \pm \frac{a}{e} = -3 \pm \frac{9}{\sqrt{5}}\) hain. (Is part ke baaqi jawab sahi hain.)
